I was walking along a beach at night with my sister, and the ocean was completely silent. The moon was enormous, much too close, and it lit up a wooden door standing in the sand. My sister said we should not open it, but I had a small silver key in my pocket and I knew it would fit. Behind the door there was a staircase going down into warm water. We walked down it without getting wet. At the bottom there was a kitchen, the one from my grandmother's house, and a black dog asleep under the table. A clock on the wall was running backwards. I sat down and poured tea for three people, although there were only two of us. Then I heard footsteps on the stairs above, slow and heavy, and I felt my stomach drop. I wanted to hide, but the dog woke up and wagged its tail, and I understood that whoever was coming was someone we had been waiting for. I woke up before I saw a face.
